stage_b_failure_mechanism.architecture_defect: Coupling Architecture Mismatch: Package 108 R1 used a two-step Abaqus input deck where both JTYPE 1 (phase) and JTYPE 2 (mechanics) were simultaneously active in Step 2. Because f42_experimental_irreversible_uel.for has zero off-diagonal Jacobian blocks (K_ud = 0, K_du = 0), Abaqus Newton-Raphson effectively executed Block-Jacobi Picard iterations. Under forward displacement loading, strong two-way field coupling produced numerical divergence and 10 consecutive cutbacks at crack-band node 1368 (phase DOF 3).
stage_b_failure_mechanism.required_correction: True alternating minimization: sequence distinct sub-steps fixing phase field during mechanical solve (e.g. *BOUNDARY on DOF 3) followed by fixing displacement during phase solve (e.g. *BOUNDARY on DOFs 1,2) with inter-iteration history update H = max(H_committed, psi_plus(u)).
